column3: “My offering” renders “my qorban,” and “My food” renders “my lechem (bread).”
“at twilight” renders “between the evenings” (also in verse 8).
NASB supplies “of an ephah” (also in verses 12–13, 20–21 and 28–29).
“every sabbath” renders “a sabbath on its sabbath.”
“two bulls” renders “two young bulls, sons of the herd” (also in verses 19 and 27).
“a tenth … for each lamb” renders “a tenth, a tenth … for the one lamb” (also in verses 21 and 29).
“each month throughout the months” renders “a month in its month for the months.”
“laborious work” renders “work of servitude” (also in verses 25–26).
“having them without defect” renders “they shall be without defect for you.”
“After this manner” renders “like these,” “daily” renders “for the day,” and “the food” renders “lechem (bread).”
“in your Feast of Weeks” renders “in your weeks.”
